_help: Shared with the Evershop-Unfulfilled portal on purpose. That Apps Script project is already authorised by its owner; a brand-new bound project is not, and Google answers an unauthorised web app with 'Access Denied', which in the portal looks exactly like a save that silently failed. The page sends sheet:'raised' so the script writes to the Raised By Sumai spreadsheet. Redeploy it with portal/deploy_apps_script.py.
